title: 第1162章 极深之域第1161章 混沌边界
slug: 玄幻开局吃软饭出世即儒圣
content_zh:
第1162章极深之域
元初的共振频率在归墟之盆膜面上刻下最后一道金色刻痕之后。
三界联合舰队用了整整三天完成全舰队的共振协议升级。
恒光在永恒回响主信标上逐段校准三网枢纽航道全段的共振频率。
将所有共建者文明的信标阵列统一切换为元初初始共振协议。
墨十七在东海工坊把新一代接力器的核心共振层整体升级。
从源之协议兼容模式切换为元初协议原生模式。
升级完成后他在工坊日志里写了一句话。
从归墟炉初代机到元初协议原生模式。
三界修东西修了这么多年。
修到尽头发现尽头是所有人的起点。
秦岳在守远号舰桥上把元初叩击记录中一组极微弱的极远空域回声单独提取出来。
逐层解码。
元初在亘古前叩响虚空之海第一声之后。
曾经收到过一组来自极远空域的回声。
回声的共振频率与元初自身的初始共振存在一个极其精密极其古老的相位偏移。
偏移幅度以极缓慢极稳定的节奏周期性波动。
每次波动都携带一组极微弱极遥远极古老的独立信息片段。
元初把这组回声完整封存在自己的叩击记录最深处。
标注为“极远之域”。

不是未知信标，不是未解明信标。
是元初用自己的共振语言给那片极远空域取的名字。
在“极远之域”的标注旁边，元初还刻了一行字迹。
此域为虚空之海极远边界。
吾等叩击至此已至极限。
此域之外仍有共振余波，然距离极远，吾等无力穿透。
若后继文明追至此处，可沿此回声继续叩。
沈无名把元初这段留言逐字逐句看完。
在灵图上那组极远空域回声的坐标旁边画了一道金色箭头。
箭头的起点是元初信标。
穿过先叩者共振底色、源之信标枢纽、初之信标枢纽。
穿过渊墟之门、叩渊者原生星域、三网枢纽航道、归墟之盆。
终点直指那片从未被任何文明触及的极远之域。
他从灵图前转过身，面对舰桥里所有人。
下达了一道极简极短的命令。
元初叩到了极限。
先叩叩到了极限。
源叩到了极限。
初叩到了极限。
渊墟叩到了极限。

叩渊者叩到了极限。
建造者叩到了极限。
每一代人都把自己的信标铺到了自己这代人的极限。
然后把下一段路留给后来者。
现在接力棒在三界手里。
content_en:
Chapter 1162 The Deep Realm
After the resonance frequency of the early Yuan Dynasty carved the last golden mark on the surface of Guixu's basin membrane.
It took the Three Realms United Fleet three full days to complete the resonance protocol upgrade for the entire fleet.
Hengguang calibrates the resonance frequency of the entire tri-network hub channel segment by segment on the eternal echo main beacon.
Unifiedly switch the beacon arrays of all co-builder civilizations to the Yuanchu Initial Resonance Protocol.
Mo Shiqi completely upgraded the core resonance layer of the new generation relay in Donghai Workshop.
Switch from source protocol compatibility mode to Yuanchu protocol native mode.
After the upgrade was completed, he wrote a sentence in the workshop log.
From the first generation machine of Guixuxu furnace to the native mode of the early Yuan Dynasty protocol.
The Three Realms have been cultivating things for so many years.
Cultivating to the end and finding the end is the starting point for everyone.
On the bridge of the Shouyuan, Qin Yue extracted a set of extremely weak echoes in the far airspace from the percussion records of the early Yuan Dynasty.
Decoding layer by layer.
At the beginning of the Yuan Dynasty, after the first sound of the sea of ​​​​emptiness was sounded in eternity.
I once received a set of echoes from extremely distant airspace.
There is an extremely precise and ancient phase shift between the resonance frequency of the echo and the initial resonance of Yuanchu itself.
The offset amplitude fluctuates periodically with a very slow and steady rhythm.
Each fluctuation carries a set of independent pieces of information that are extremely weak, distant, and ancient.
At the beginning of the Yuan Dynasty, this set of echoes was completely sealed in the deepest part of his percussion records.
Labeled "The Realm of Far Far Away".
Not an unknown beacon, not an unexplained beacon.
It was the name given to that extremely distant space in the early Yuan Dynasty using his own resonant language.
Next to the label "Extremely Far Realm", there was also a line of writing engraved in the early Yuan Dynasty.
This domain is the farthest boundary of the Sea of ​​Void.
Our knocking has reached its limit.
There are still resonance aftermaths outside this domain, but the distance is so far that we are unable to penetrate.
If subsequent civilizations catch up to this place, they can continue to knock along this echo.
Shen Wuming read this message from the beginning of the Yuan Dynasty word for word.
A golden arrow was drawn next to the coordinates of the extremely distant airspace echo on the spiritual map.
The starting point of the arrow is the beacon of the early Yuan Dynasty.
Pass through the resonant background of the first knocker, the beacon hub of the source, and the beacon hub of the beginning.
Pass through the gate of Yuanxu, the original star field of the Knocker, the three-network hub channel, and the basin of Guixu.
The end point points directly to that far-flung territory that has never been touched by any civilization.
He turned around from the spiritual diagram and faced everyone on the bridge.
A very simple and short order was issued.
In the early Yuan Dynasty, the limit was reached.
Knock to the limit first.
Yuan knocked to the limit.
The first knock reached the limit.
Yuanxu reached its limit.
Those who knock on the abyss knock to the limit.
Builders hit their limits.
Each generation spreads its beacon to the limit of its own generation.
Then leave the next section of the road to those who come after you.
Now the baton is in the hands of the Three Realms.
